goal: Repair the KV metadata overflow defect when a task review is registered, with offline red/green regression. No production deploy, no real review registration, no D1 operation.

defect.summary: saveTask copied the whole registry entry, including review_note and review_event.note, into the Cloudflare KV metadata object. A single real review note was therefore duplicated into metadata twice.
defect.location: worker/index.js saveTask (pre-fix: `const { task_id, dispatch_contract, dispatch_events, ...meta } = entry; put(..., { metadata: meta })`)
defect.reported_trigger: A 611-byte note, duplicated into review_note + review_event.note, already exceeded the 1024-byte serialized UTF-8 metadata limit.

fix.approach: Keep the complete original review content (review_note, review_event, review_dispatch, dispatch_contract, dispatch_events and unknown fields) in the JSON value read back by readTask. Write only a bounded projection into KV metadata.

degradation_order: shrink string fields via 128/64/32/16/8/0 byte limits
last-resort core-field projection with metadata_bounded = true
bounding_policy.non_leaking: Objects/arrays and unknown fields are never copied to metadata; the note payload is represented by booleans only.

fix.other_write_paths: recordTask now also routes its initial metadata through buildTaskMetadata so every write to TASK_REGISTRY is bounded.

consumer_enumeration.review_consumer: reviewed/review_verdict/reviewed_at plus bounded presence flags are preserved; the full review_note/review_event remains available to consumers via readTask (value).

red_evidence.observed: The KV mock recorded serialized metadata of 2773-12271 UTF-8 bytes, far above the 1024-byte bound, and review_note/review_event were present in metadata.

focused_suite.command: python -m pytest tests/test_autonomous_advancement.py tests/test_dispatch_retry_executor.py tests/test_supervisor_lineage_filter.py tests/test_status_contract_v0_2.py tests/test_submit_task_mode_passthrough.py tests/test_mark_reviewed_gate.py -q

online_evidence_boundary.observation: Both a long note and a 79-byte short note returned Internal error, and the review fields remained null.
online_evidence_boundary.interpretation: This task repairs a reproducible source-level metadata bounds defect. It does NOT confirm the online root cause and does NOT prove the online error has been fixed.

not_executed: real Cloudflare D1 (ASSET_DB) read or write
production Worker deployment (wrangler deploy / Canonical write)
real next-task dispatch to production GitHub
browser authorization bypass or permission widening (none attempted)
workflow / binding / schema / secret / permission changes
